cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)
project(auction_p0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
# P0 factorial: all C++ Release /MD; vary only SQLite /Od|/O2 and debug defines.
set(P0_SQLITE_OPT "O2" CACHE STRING "OD or O2")
option(P0_SQLITE_DEBUG "Enable exactly the vcpkg Debug SQLite definitions" OFF)
set(P0_SQLITE_SOURCE "sqlite3534" CACHE STRING "sqlite3534 or gdsqlite/src/sqlite")
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreadedDLL")
set(GODOTCPP_API_VERSION "4.7" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(GODOTCPP_TARGET "template_debug" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(GODOTCPP_USE_STATIC_CPP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GODOTCPP_BUILD_PROFILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/build_profile.json" CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(godotcpp)
add_library(p0_sqlite STATIC ${P0_SQLITE_SOURCE}/sqlite3.c)
target_include_directories(p0_sqlite PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${P0_SQLITE_SOURCE}")
if(P0_SQLITE_OPT STREQUAL "OD")
    target_compile_options(p0_sqlite PRIVATE /Od)
elseif(P0_SQLITE_OPT STREQUAL "O2")
    target_compile_options(p0_sqlite PRIVATE /O2)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid P0 SQLite optimization control")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(p0_sqlite PRIVATE SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA=1 SQLITE_ENABLE_UNLOCK_NOTIFY=1)
if(P0_SQLITE_DEBUG)
    target_compile_definitions(p0_sqlite PRIVATE SQLITE_DEBUG=1 SQLITE_ENABLE_SELECTTRACE SQLITE_ENABLE_WHERETRACE)
endif()
# Give SOCI the explicitly selected target, bypassing ambiguous find_library paths.
add_library(SQLite3::SQLite3 ALIAS p0_sqlite)
add_library(SQLite::SQLite3 ALIAS p0_sqlite)
set(SQLite3_FOUND TRUE CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SOCI_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SOCI_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SOCI_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SOCI_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SOCI_LTO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WITH_BOOST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
foreach(backend DB2 EMPTY FIREBIRD MYSQL ODBC ORACLE POSTGRESQL)
    set(SOCI_${backend} OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endforeach()
set(SOCI_SQLITE3 ON CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SOCI_SQLITE3_BUILTIN OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(fmt_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/fmt")
add_subdirectory(fmt)
add_subdirectory(soci)
add_library(p0_soci SHARED addon/src/database.cpp addon/src/query_dispatcher.cpp addon/src/query_request.cpp addon/src/query_worker.cpp addon/src/register_types.cpp gdsqlite/src/gdsqlite.cpp gdsqlite/src/vfs/gdsqlite_vfs.cpp gdsqlite/src/vfs/gdsqlite_file.cpp)
target_include_directories(p0_soci PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" addon/include gdsqlite/src)
target_compile_features(p0_soci PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(p0_soci PRIVATE /EHsc)
target_link_libraries(p0_soci PRIVATE godot-cpp SOCI::SQLite3)
target_include_directories(soci_sqlite3 PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_features(soci_sqlite3 PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
set_target_properties(p0_soci PROPERTIES PREFIX "" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
# gdsqlite's include path is sqlite/sqlite3.h; use the same pinned 3.53.4 header.
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/headers/sqlite")
configure_file(${P0_SQLITE_SOURCE}/sqlite3.h "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/headers/sqlite/sqlite3.h" COPYONLY)
target_include_directories(p0_soci BEFORE PRIVATE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/headers")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/soci-p0.gdextension" CONTENT "[configuration]\nentry_symbol=\"godot_soci_library_init\"\ncompatibility_minimum=\"4.7\"\n[libraries]\nwindows.x86_64.single.debug=\"./bin/Release/p0_soci.dll\"\n")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/configuration.json" "{\"sqlite_source\":\"${P0_SQLITE_SOURCE}\",\"sqlite_opt\":\"${P0_SQLITE_OPT}\",\"sqlite_debug\":\"${P0_SQLITE_DEBUG}\",\"cpp_configuration\":\"Release\",\"compiler\":\"${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID} ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_VERSION}\"}\n")
